senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חָרַר III)to be charred, black.—V. שָׁחוֹר I.
to blacken. Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ הִשְׁחִירוּ פניהן וכ׳ they made their faces as black as the bottom of a pot, i.e. they ruined their reputation.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 152a:14">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 11:10">Koh. XI, 10</cite>) <he>דברים … מַשְׁחִירִים וכ׳</he> certain things which a man does in his young days make his face look black (sickly) in his old age; a. e.

senses.gloss: to become black. Y. Bets. II, end, 61ᵈ הִשְׁחִירוּ שיניו וכ׳ his teeth were black from fasting; Y. Sabb. V, end, 7ᶜ; Ḥag. 22ᵇ הוּשְׁחֲרוּ שיניו (Hof.; Ms. M. פניו).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (play on <cite ref="A03281"><he>אשחור</he></cite>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 1:24">II Chr. I, 24</cite>) <he>שחִשְׁחִירוּ פניו בתעניות</he> his face was black from fasting. Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᵈ bot. <he>מכיון שה׳</he> as soon as it (the onion in the ground) gets black. Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ <he>הִשְׁחִירָה הקדרה</he>, v. <cite ref="B01359"><he>בָּשַׁל</he></cite>; a. e.
